cat > /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Checkpoint watchdog: auto-delete old checkpoints after new ones are saved

LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.log"
echo "$(date) Watchdog started" >> "$LOG"

while true; do
  # Seed 5: step 10 saved → delete step 5
  if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_10" ] && \
     [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_5" ]; then
    rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_5
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed5 step_5" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  # Seed 5: step 15 saved → delete step 10
  if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_15" ] && \
     [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_10" ]; then
    rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed5/global_step_10
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed5 step_10" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  # Seed 6: step 10 saved → delete step 5
  if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_10" ] && \
     [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_5" ]; then
    rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_5
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed6 step_5" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  # Seed 6: step 15 saved → delete step 10
  if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_15" ] && \
     [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_10" ]; then
    rm -rf /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed6/global_step_10
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed6 step_10" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  sleep 60
done
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh && nohup bash /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo "Watchdog PID: $!"
